standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Steady pace for people learning alongside work or studies.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Fast track in about half the time. Alerts fire sooner.

levels.name: Java Basics
levels.project: Temperature converter: read Celsius and print Fahrenheit.

topics.name: class with main()
topics.try: Write a class with public static void main and run it.

topics.name: System.out.println
topics.try: Print two lines with System.out.println.

topics.name: primitive variables
topics.try: Declare an int, a double and a boolean and print them.

topics.name: String
topics.try: Store your name in a String and print it.

topics.name: Scanner input
topics.try: Read a name with Scanner and greet the user.

topics.name: operators
topics.try: Add two ints, then compare them with >.

topics.name: comments
topics.try: Explain a line of code with a // comment.

levels.name: Control Flow
levels.project: Number guessing game with a limited number of tries.

topics.name: if / else
topics.try: Print whether a number is positive, negative or zero.

topics.name: switch
topics.try: Print a day name from a number with a switch.

topics.name: for loop
topics.try: Print the numbers 1 to 10 with a for loop.

topics.name: while and do-while
topics.try: Keep asking for a number with a while loop until the user enters 0.

topics.name: break and continue
topics.try: Skip even numbers with continue and stop at 20 with break.

levels.name: Arrays & Strings
levels.project: Word counter: count the words and vowels in a sentence.

topics.name: arrays
topics.try: Store five scores in an int[] and print the third.

topics.name: enhanced for loop
topics.try: Sum an array with for (int x : numbers).

topics.name: 2D arrays
topics.try: Build a 3x3 grid with int[][] and print it.

topics.name: String methods
topics.try: Use length(), toUpperCase() and charAt() on a word.

topics.name: StringBuilder
topics.try: Build a string in a loop with StringBuilder.append.

levels.name: Methods
levels.project: Calculator with a separate method for each operation.

topics.name: static methods

topics.name: parameters and return
topics.try: Write int add(int a, int b) and print its result.

topics.name: method overloading
topics.try: Write two add methods, one for ints and one for doubles.

topics.name: recursion
topics.try: Compute a factorial with a method that calls itself.

levels.name: Classes & Objects
levels.project: Bank account class with deposit and withdraw that refuses overdrafts.

topics.name: class and new
topics.try: Create a Dog class and make an object with new Dog().

topics.name: constructors
topics.try: Add a constructor that sets the dog's name.

topics.name: this keyword
topics.try: Use this.name = name inside a constructor.

topics.name: private fields with getters
topics.try: Make a field private and add getName() and setName().

topics.name: static members
topics.try: Count created objects with a static counter.

levels.name: Inheritance & Interfaces
levels.project: Shapes program: Circle and Rectangle share an interface and report their area.

topics.name: extends
topics.try: Make Dog extend Animal and call an inherited method.

topics.name: super
topics.try: Call super(name) in a subclass constructor.

topics.name: @Override
topics.try: Override speak() in a subclass with @Override.

topics.name: abstract classes
topics.try: Declare an abstract class with an abstract method.

topics.name: interfaces
topics.try: Write an interface and implement it in two classes.

topics.name: polymorphism
topics.try: Store a Dog in an Animal variable and call speak().

levels.name: Exceptions & Files
levels.project: Notes app that saves notes to a file and reads them back.

topics.name: try / catch / finally
topics.try: Catch an ArithmeticException from dividing by zero.

topics.name: throw and throws
topics.try: Throw an IllegalArgumentException for a negative age.

topics.name: custom exception
topics.try: Write class MyException extends Exception and throw it.

topics.name: try-with-resources

topics.name: reading files
topics.try: Print every line of a text file with BufferedReader.

topics.name: writing files
